fixture_hash_recipe: SHA-256 over sorted relative paths: (1) enumerate every file under plant_tests/PT-G6/fixture/ recursively, relative paths with '/' separators; (2) per file compute lowercase hex SHA-256 of raw file bytes; (3) build line '<rel-path>  <hex-digest>\n' (two-space separator, LF terminator, UTF-8); (4) sort lines lexicographically by rel-path (byte order); (5) fixture_hash = lowercase hex SHA-256 over the concatenation of sorted lines, no extra terminator. Computed by the custodian at freeze (S0_GOAL_ADR.md section 1 item 4); recipe frozen, change forces re-freeze.
